spans.s:
m. (-ष्वः)
A spiritual preceptor.
E.
इष to wish, वन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
A thrower of arrows.
m. (-सः)
1 A bow.
2 An archer, a warrior.
E.
इषु an arrow, and आस who throws.

m. (-रः)
1 The supreme ruler of the universe, GOD; it is therefore applied to all the different divinities, but mostly designates ŚIVA, in mythological and popular acceptation. According to the Sāṃkhyas, Īśvara is the liberated spirit; finite, according to KAPILA; in finite, according to PATAÑJALI. In the Nyāya system, Īśvara is also a finite spirit endowed with attributes. In the Vedānta, Īśvara is infinite and universal spirit, [] the cause and substance of creation.
2 A name of ŚIVA, especially in a compound, when the form of the deity implied is a Liṅga, as, Viśveśvara, Someśvara, Rāmeśvara, &c.
3 KĀMADEVA.
mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 An owner, a proprietor, a chief or head.
2 Able, competent.
f. (-रा or -री)
1 A name of

Of LAKṢMĪ, or of any other of the Śaktis or female energies of the deities.
E.
ईश to rule, and वरट् or वरच् affix, consequently ङीप् or टाप् for the feminine.

m. (-वः)
Royal or imperial nature.
E.
ईश्वर a sovereign, and भाव disposition.

n. (-भं)
A royal court or assembly.
E.
ईश्वर and सभा an assembly.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Subject to a king, dependant, on A master or on GOD, &c.
E.
ईश्वर, अधि over, ख aff.

f. (-ता)
Dependance upon GOD, subjection to a ruler.
E.
ईश्वराधीन and तल् added; also with त्व, ईश्वराधीनत्व.
